description: This file defines an interface and a class related to a durable object that performs no operations, used for retiring other durable types within the Orleans framework. It includes dependency injection, state machine registration, and no-op implementations of state machine methods.

classes.name: DurableNothing
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IDurableNothing and IDurableStateMachine, representing a no-op durable object used for retiring other durable types.

methods.name: DurableNothing
methods.description: Constructor that registers the durable object with a state machine manager, ensuring the key is not null or empty.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: No-op implementation of the IDurableStateMachine.Reset method.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: No-op implementation of the IDurableStateMachine.Apply method.

methods.name: AppendEntries
methods.description: No-op implementation of the IDurableStateMachine.AppendEntries method.

methods.name: AppendSnapshot
methods.description: No-op implementation of the IDurableStateMachine.AppendSnapshot method.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Returns a deep copy of the object, which in this case is the object itself.
